stops.name: Roman amphitheatre
stops.quote: In Brugg and Windisch, at the southern foot of the Jura, you can immerse yourself in the history of two empires from the first few minutes: the Roman amphitheatre, the Vindonissa Legionnaires' path with the only Roman legionnaires' camp in Switzerland and the Habsburg monastery of Königsfelden take you on a journey into the past.
stops.english: In Brugg and Windisch, at the southern foot of the Jura, you can immerse yourself in the history of two empires from the first few minutes: the Roman amphitheatre, the Vindonissa Legionnaires' path with the only Roman legionnaires' camp in Switzerland and the Habsburg monastery of Königsfelden take you on a journey into the past.

stops.name: Aare
stops.quote: Along the Aare, alluvial zones, secluded bays, wooded islands and sandbanks will delight you.
stops.english: Along the Aare, alluvial zones, secluded bays, wooded islands and sandbanks will delight you.

stops.name: Rhine
stops.quote: Passing quiet hamlets, you reach the banks of the Rhine.
stops.english: Passing quiet hamlets, you reach the banks of the Rhine.

stops.name: Laufenburg
stops.quote: Laufenburg's terraced old town, with its towers and historic town wall nestled in the bend of the Rhine, is fascinating.
stops.english: Laufenburg's terraced old town, with its towers and historic town wall nestled in the bend of the Rhine, is fascinating.

stops.name: upper Fricktal
stops.quote: A little later, you enter the upper Fricktal with its high-crowned orchards.
stops.english: A little later, you enter the upper Fricktal with its high-crowned orchards.

stops.name: Aare riverside path
stops.quote: Along the beautiful Aare riverside path, you leisurely coast to Brugg.
stops.english: Along the beautiful Aare riverside path, you leisurely coast to Brugg.
